import.title: Import from DBU
import.intro: For clubs in Denmark. Find your club and we'll bring in its crest, colours, fixtures and results, with your opponents' crests.
import.pickIntro: Tick every competition your team plays in, like the league and the cup. Fixtures, results and the opponents' crests come with them.
import.tooShort: Type at least two letters of the club's name.
import.noHits: No clubs on DBU match “{query}”. Try part of the name.
import.noTeams: DBU doesn't list any of this club's teams in a competition right now.
import.source: Read from dbu.dk's public results pages. No DBU login needed.

errors.network: Couldn't reach teamsheet11. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unavailable: DBU didn't answer. Try again in a minute.
errors.changed: DBU's pages have changed, so the import can't read them right now. Add the details by hand for now.
errors.notFound: DBU has no page for this match. It may have been moved: update your fixtures from DBU.
errors.unknownTeam: DBU doesn't list that team for this club any more. Pick the teams again.
errors.rateLimited: That's a lot of DBU lookups. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.other: Something went wrong. Try again in a minute.

setup.prompt: Club in Denmark? Bring in your crest, colours and fixtures from DBU.
setup.done: {count, plural, one {Imported from DBU with # fixture.} other {Imported from DBU with # fixtures.}}

fixtures.upToDate: Your fixtures are up to date with DBU
fixtures.matchSet: The match graphics are set for {opponent}.
fixtures.used: The match graphics are set for {opponent}

match.title: Get from DBU
match.buttonMatch: Get line-up and result from DBU
match.introHome: Home against {opponent}. DBU shows the team sheet once it's handed in, and goals and substitutions as they're reported.
match.introAway: Away against {opponent}. DBU shows the team sheet once it's handed in, and goals and substitutions as they're reported.
match.loading: Looking at DBU's page for the match…
match.lineupNew: {count, plural, one {# isn't in your squad yet and will be added.} other {# aren't in your squad yet and will be added.}}
match.lineupPositions: The team sheet has no positions, so check them after.
match.lineupNone: DBU doesn't show your team sheet for this match yet.
match.scoreDetail: {score}{live, select, yes { so far} other {}}, {count, plural, one {# goal with its scorer} other {# goals with their scorers}}.
match.scoreTyped: DBU's timeline doesn't have every goal, so the score is typed in as DBU has it.
match.replaces: This replaces what you have for this match now: {parts}.
match.playersAdded: {count, plural, one {# player was added to the squad.} other {# players were added to the squad.}} Check their positions.
